text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...A detour? Indeed, I have no plans 
after this, but..."
choice_data_list:
Taking breaks is important too, so how 
about it?

text_block_list.text:
Being able to devote herself entirely to 
racing is very Duramente, and a wonderful 
strength... but enjoying everyday life as 
a student is important too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Big sis Groove said it too. That 
taking time to look beyond the track is 
important.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Let's give it a try, taking this detour 
with you.

And so, we first visited a shop that's 
popular with the academy's Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Looks delicious! Do you like pineapple?
Looks delicious! Do you like pineapple?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I prioritized nutrition. It aids 
digestion and helps with fatigue recovery. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...The merchandise here really strains the 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... To think there was a park this 
spacious.
choice_data_list:
If I remember right, they're famous for 
their beautiful flower beds...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However... it's not suited for running. 
Cobblestones this hard will ruin your 
ankles.

We went around looking at various other 
things after that, but I remained unsure 
whether she was truly enjoying herself...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for showing me around, Trainer. 
So this is what it means to take a detour.
choice_data_list:
...Yeah, let's do it again sometime if 
you'd like!

text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I want to help them relax 
their shoulders and have a good time. 
Thinking that—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This song is...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is this—a cafe?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...The classical piece playing right now 
is one I often listen to in my room. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: More than that, the sound is softer.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome, young customer.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"I still hold the record even now. It's 
something I've been proud of for years."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...A record.
choice_data_list: ...Shall we stay and listen for a bit?

text_block_list.text:
Together with her, I listen closely to the 
classical music flowing from the record 
player.

The gentle melody slowly flows into my 
ears, filling my entire body...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Has it ended already? That one song.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It was a strange feeling. ...I can't put 
it into words very well, though.

Stepping away from the bustle of the 
academy and daily life to focus on gentle 
sounds feels just like—
choice_data_list:
It felt like my body was sinking into the 
sound...

It felt like my body was sinking into the 
sound...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...! Precisely so.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It was the same when listening before bed, 
but... the wave-like sense of relief felt 
even more comforting.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...To think you were like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We had good communication. ...Even off the 
track.
choice_data_list: I'd love to come back again.
I'd love to come back again.
I really felt the charm of the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
We had good communication. ...Even off the 
track.
choice_data_list: I'd love to come back again.
I'd love to come back again.
I really felt the charm of the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Let's come back again.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I, too, was able to experience the charm 
of vinyl records. You have my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: So this is taking a detour... I see.
